title: Agent-Impact Guardrail Policy
description: Machine-readable guardrail policy exported by Agent-Impact (https://lab.krismccabe.com/agent-impact/), describing the Blast Radius and Irreversibility assessment for a single AI-agent action against a Salesforce object, and the guardrails that should gate it.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this policy was generated, in the user's browser.

target.description: The object and action this policy governs.

object.description: The Salesforce SObject API name the agent action targets.

action.description: The type of action the agent is about to perform.

batchSize.description: Number of records touched in a single execution.

activeFlowCount.description: Count of active record-triggered Flows on the target object, factored into the Blast Radius score as an automation force multiplier.

hasSideEffects.description: Whether the action triggers external side effects (webhooks, emails, third-party API calls) that cannot be undone by rolling back the record.

metrics.description: The computed risk metrics for this action.

blastRadiusScore.description: 0-100 score combining the action's base severity, the target object's cascade-delete/standard-child/lookup exposure, active automation, and batch size.

irreversibilityIndex.description: 0-100% estimate of how hard this action is to undo, from hard deletes, external side effects, and cascade-delete dependencies.

riskTier.description: LOW (score < 20), MEDIUM (20-44), HIGH (45-74, requires human-in-the-loop), CRITICAL (score >= 75 or irreversibility >= 70%, mandatory human approval and batch size restriction).

guardrails.description: The enforceable guardrails derived from the metrics above.

humanApprovalRequired.description: True when riskTier is HIGH or CRITICAL — the action must not proceed without explicit human confirmation.

batchSizeRestricted.description: True when riskTier is CRITICAL — the action should be limited to maxBatchSize per execution.

maxBatchSize.description: The enforced maximum batch size when batchSizeRestricted is true, otherwise null.
